description: This is a PHP source file defining the `Stash` class which acts as a REST client for interacting with Atlassian's Stash (Bitbucket Server) API, providing methods to retrieve user info, projects, repositories, repository contents, branches, commits, and specific project details.

classes.name: Stash
classes.description: A class providing methods to interact with the Atlassian Stash (Bitbucket Server) REST API, including obtaining user info, projects, repositories, branches, commits, and content.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Stash client, sets configuration parameters, and prepares a RestRequest instance.

methods.name: configCheck
methods.description: Validates that the essential configuration parameters like host, username, and password are set.

methods.name: testLogin
methods.description: Tests the login credentials by attempting to retrieve the user and checking request status.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Fetches user information for a given username.

methods.name: getProjects
methods.description: Retrieves a list of projects the user has access to.

methods.name: getRepos
methods.description: Retrieves repositories within a specified project, optionally filtering by repository name.

methods.name: getRepoContent
methods.description: Gets the contents of a repository at a specified path, branch, or commit.

methods.name: getBranches
methods.description: Retrieves branches for a specific repository.

methods.name: getCommits
methods.description: Gets recent commits for a repository, optionally filtered by branch name.

methods.name: getProject
methods.description: Fetches detailed information about a specific project.
